semiconductor_relevance: High — Georg Fischer Piping Systems Ltd. specializes in mission-critical fluid handling solutions essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Georg Fischer Piping Systems Ltd. provides comprehensive fluid handling solutions tailored for the semiconductor industry, focusing on sustainable water resource management and environmental impact reduction. Their product offerings include plastic pipes, fittings, valves, and measurement and control systems that support the efficient operation of semiconductor fabrication facilities.
capabilities: Plastic pipes and fittings for fluid transport
Valves and actuation systems for process control
Automation and measurement systems for fluid management

regional_presence.Switzerland: Headquartered in Switzerland, Georg Fischer employs around 13,300 professionals across 46 countries.
